description.value: While at least one other Ratkin is within 15 feet, gain a circumstance bonus to Aid Another, to Diplomacy checks to Request aid, and to Survival checks to Subsist or find safe warren-ground.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'A circumstance bonus' to Aid, Diplomacy (Request), and Survival (Subsist) states no numeric value, even though the action tags themselves (aid, request, subsist) are all real and confirmed. The card states a bonus/effect but gives no numeric value or formula to build a rule element from without inventing one.
